author: Dohmen, R. and others
title: Test of lepton flavor conservation in mu -> e conversion on titanium
abstract: A search for mu->e conversion in muonic atoms using the SINDRUM II spectrometer at PSI. A first measurement on Ti gives upper limits on the branching ratios for ground-state transitions of R(mu- Ti -> e- Ti g.s.) / R(mu- Ti capture) < 4.3e-12 and R(mu- Ti -> e+ Ca g.s.) / R(mu- Ti capture) < 4.3e-12 (90% CL).
